dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate trailing edge characterized by a deep concave spline extending from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with an obtuse geometric profile and a measurable pixel radius at the maximum elevation point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with a steepness of approximately 40 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 1.8 times the vertical height from the dorsal ridge to the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a dark, horizontal linear indentation/scar at the mid-base of the dorsal fin. Significant epidermal mottling and irregular pale patches suggestive of localized depigmentation or scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-contrast speckling and white-to-gray pigment patches covering the majority of the visible dorsal fin and lateral flank.
